LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Praise_Desc: Say something kind about them and their leader. Honourable factions and gentle, courtly or festive ones like it; suspicious, martial and aloof ones see through flattery.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Complain_Desc: Complain about what they did to you. Honourable factions may apologise, which eases your grievance against them; proud or aggressive ones take offence. Being stronger than them helps.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_AskRivals_Desc: Ask whom they trust least and most. Reveals their true opinion of two factions and adds a little intel on them. Paranoid factions that do not like you will not say.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_AskWants_Desc: Ask what they want from you or the world: help in a war, amends, a treaty, aid, silver. Being asked pleases them a little.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_ShareRumour_Desc: Tell them something unflattering about another faction. If they believe it they think less of that faction and better of you; if not, they think you are meddling. Easier about a faction they already distrust and one you know well.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Warn_Desc: Warn them of a danger: a warband on its way, a war, a rival spoiling for a fight. A real warning earns gratitude, even from enemies; a false alarm makes you look foolish.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Cooldown: Can be raised again with them after {0} days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Shuns: {0} shuns outsiders and will not talk until they like you better.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_NoGrievance: You have no grievance against {0} worth raising.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_NoOneElse: There is no one else to ask about.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Odds_Distrust: How they already see that faction
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Odds_Intel: How well you know that faction
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Want_Nothing: {0} wants nothing from you at present.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Want_Amends: amends for what you did to them
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Rumour_Bad: {0} did not believe you about {1} and thinks you are meddling.
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Threat_Warband: {0} has a warband marching on them
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Threat_War: their war with {0} could turn worse
LanguageData.Dominion_Talk_Threat_Rival: {0} is spoiling for a fight with them
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_SmallTalk: Quiet season here. And with you?|The harvest held. Can't complain.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Praised: Kind of you to say.|We'll take the compliment.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Apology: Fair point. We'll make it right.|You're right. That was badly done.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Rebuff: Not interested.|We'd rather not discuss it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Confide: Between us, then.|Here's how it stands.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Warned: Thanks for the warning. We'll be ready.|Good to know. We owe you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Plain_Bargain: Let's see the numbers.|We can talk business.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_SmallTalk: The season's balls have been tolerable, thank you.|The court is in good spirits, as befits it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Praised: Flattery, but well turned. The court approves.|How perceptive of you to notice.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Apology: The court concedes a regrettable lapse. It shall be mended.|Very well. The crown extends its regrets.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Rebuff: The court does not discuss such matters with commoners.|That is not a fit subject for this audience.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Confide: The court will share this much, in confidence.|Listen closely; this will not be repeated.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Warned: The crown thanks you for your vigilance.|A timely word. The court will remember it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Courtly_Bargain: The treasury will hear your proposal.|Name your terms, and be reasonable.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_SmallTalk: The faithful pray, the fields grow. All is as willed.|The temples are full. And yours?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Praised: Praise rightly given rises to heaven.|Your words honour the chosen of {0}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Apology: Even the faithful may err. We atone.|It is confessed. Penance will be done.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Rebuff: That is not for unbelievers to know.|Silence. Some things are sacred.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Confide: The oracle has spoken thus.|Hear what has been revealed to us.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Warned: The heavens sent you to warn us. We are grateful.|A warning from a stranger is still a sign. Thank you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Divine_Bargain: Even the temple must keep its stores. Speak.|The faithful trade honestly. Make your offer.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_SmallTalk: Every day the truth wins more hearts.|We have no time for idle words, but go on.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Praised: Praise the faith, not us.|The truth shines through us. You see it too.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Apology: We were overzealous. The faith forgives; so must we.|Wrong was done. We will mend it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Rebuff: We do not share with the unconverted.|Convert, and then ask.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Confide: The faithful see much. Listen.|We will tell you what the faith has seen.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Warned: The enemies of the faith gather? Let them come. But thank you.|A warning well given. The faithful will be ready.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Zealous_Bargain: The cause needs supplies. Speak.|Trade, then. The faith provides.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_SmallTalk: The nights are long here. We like them that way.|Things grow in the dark. Things always grow.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Praised: How... sweet.|Your words taste of fear. And respect.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Apology: Perhaps we were... careless. It will not happen again.|An error. We will make it disappear.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Rebuff: Some doors stay closed, little colony.|You do not want to know.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Confide: We hear whispers. Here is one.|Listen. The dark tells us things.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Warned: We knew. But it is touching that you told us.|Interesting. We will prepare a... welcome.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Eerie_Bargain: We trade in many things. Some of them are goods.|Name your price. We will name ours.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_SmallTalk: Training. Raiding. The usual.|Our warriors are bored. What do you want?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Praised: Ha! Flatter us all you like. We're still armed.|Strong words. We like strong words.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Apology: Fine. Our fighters went too far. Done.|We'll pay for the broken heads. This time.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Rebuff: Mind your own business.|Ask again and lose a tooth.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Confide: Here's who we'd fight next. And who we wouldn't.|Listen up. We say this once.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Warned: Someone wants a fight? Good. Thanks for the tip.|A warning? Ha. We'll be waiting with steel.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Martial_Bargain: Weapons, food, silver. What're you selling?|Trade's for the weak. But fine.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_SmallTalk: The training yards are full and the tea is hot. All is well.|We keep to our ways. And you?
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Praised: You honour us. We will honour you in return.|Kind words between equals. Thank you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Apology: We were wrong. We apologise, without condition.|Our honour demands we make amends.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Rebuff: That would not be honourable to share.|Forgive us; we cannot speak of it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Confide: Since you ask honestly, we answer honestly.|This is the truth, as we know it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Warned: You warn even those who are not your friends. That is honour.|We are in your debt for this warning.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Honourable_Bargain: A fair trade is a kind of honour. Speak.|We will deal fairly, if you do.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_SmallTalk: Production quotas are being met.|Order is maintained. That is all.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Apology: An irregularity occurred. It has been corrected.|The responsible officials have been disciplined.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Confide: The following is released to you.|The state's assessment is as follows.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Warned: Your report has been forwarded to the ministry.|Intelligence received. Defences are being raised.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Stern_Bargain: Submit your terms to the trade ministry.|The state will consider an exchange.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_SmallTalk: ...It is quiet. We prefer quiet.|Nothing to report. As always.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Apology: We will stay out of your way.|...It was a mistake. It is over.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Confide: Only this, and then leave us.|Fine. One answer.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Warned: We had not noticed. ...Thank you.|We will watch the horizon.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Aloof_Bargain: If we must trade, be quick.|State the goods. Nothing more.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_SmallTalk: Markets are up, margins are thin. Same as ever!|Business is good. Could be better. Always could!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Praised: Flattery is free. We prefer silver, but thank you!|Kind words are good for business.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Apology: Our mistake. Consider it written off.|We'll make it right. Reputation is everything.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Rebuff: That's proprietary information.|Trade secret, I'm afraid.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Confide: Information is a commodity. This one's on the house.|Here's what the market's saying.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Warned: Risk averted is profit saved. Thank you!|We'll adjust our forecasts. Much obliged.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Mercantile_Bargain: Now we're talking. What's on the table?|Let's make a deal everyone walks away from happy.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_SmallTalk: We had a feast last night. You should've come!|Music, wine, dancing. The usual!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Praised: Oh, stop it! ...No, go on.|You're too kind! Let's drink to that!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Apology: Oops. Our fault. Let us make it up to you!|Sorry, sorry. Next round's on us.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Rebuff: Boring! Ask us something fun.|Let's not spoil the mood with that.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Confide: Ooh, gossip! Here's what we've heard.|Lean in, this one's juicy.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Warned: Trouble's coming? Then we'll party harder first. Thank you!|Good thing you told us. We owe you a drink.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Festive_Bargain: Trading? Can there be wine involved?|Sure, let's make a deal and celebrate it!
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_SmallTalk: The children are well, and the gardens are green.|It has been a peaceful season. We hope yours was too.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Praised: Thank you. That warms our hearts.|You are very kind.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Apology: We are so sorry. We will put it right.|You are right, and we apologise.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Rebuff: We'd rather not speak ill of anyone.|Please, let's talk of something else.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Confide: We'll tell you, so that no one gets hurt.|In the hope it helps keep the peace:
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Warned: Thank you for caring about us.|We will get our people to safety. Thank you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Gentle_Bargain: We're happy to share what we have.|Let's trade, so both our peoples prosper.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_SmallTalk: The council's agenda is long, as ever.|We debated irrigation for six hours. Riveting.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Praised: The council will be pleased to hear it.|Your remarks are entered into the record.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Apology: The council acknowledges the fault and offers its apology.|After review, we accept responsibility.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Rebuff: That matter is before a committee.|We are not at liberty to discuss it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Confide: The council's briefing, in short:|For your information, the council's view:
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Warned: The council thanks you. Measures will be taken.|Your warning will be tabled as urgent.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Collegial_Bargain: The trade committee is in session. Proceed.|Present your proposal for consideration.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_SmallTalk: The hunt was good. The children grow.|Rain came. The river is full.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Praised: Good words. The elders smile.|You speak well, outlander.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Apology: Our young ones were foolish. We make it right.|The tribe was wrong. We give you peace.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Rebuff: That is for the tribe, not you.|The elders say no.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Confide: The scouts saw this. Listen.|The fire-talk says this.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Warned: You warn us. You are a friend to the tribe.|Our hunters will watch. Thank you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Voice_Tribal_Bargain: Show us what you trade.|We trade skins and food. You?
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Trade_Desc: Trade with {0} over the wire, in the usual trade window. What you buy comes down by drop pod; you sell what lies near your orbital trade beacons, as with orbital traders. Their office keeps its stock for {1} days. Afterwards you may offer to repeat the trade as a standing deal.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_TheyEmbargo: {0} has placed an embargo on you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_WeEmbargo: You have placed an embargo on {0}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_NoHome: You have no home to deliver to.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_NoNegotiator: No colonist at home is able to talk to them.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Terms: If you cannot pay or deliver when a delivery is due, the deal is suspended and they lose {0} goodwill toward you. Calling it off early costs {1} goodwill. War or an embargo ends it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_LogRefused: {0} would not make it a standing deal.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_TheyShort: {0} could not fill the whole order from their stores, and charged less.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Missed_Silver: You could not pay the {0} silver due to {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Missed_Goods: You could not hand over the {0} due to {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_MissedText: The standing deal with {0} is suspended and they lost {1} goodwill toward you. Resume it from the Diplomacy tab once you can keep your side.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_State_Active: Next delivery in {0}; {1} made so far.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_State_Suspended: Suspended after {0} missed delivery(s). Resume it when you can keep your side.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Cancel_Desc: End this deal now. Calling it off before it has run its course costs {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.Dominion_Deal_Resume_Desc: Pick the deal up again: the next delivery comes tomorrow. Make sure you can pay or hand over the goods.
LanguageData.Dominion_Standing_Intro: You have traded with {0}. Offer to make the same trade again on a schedule: the same goods and the same silver, delivered by drop pod. Their stores in Economics & Demography decide how much they can send each time.
LanguageData.Dominion_Standing_Sign_Desc: Sign and send the offer to {0}. They read it and seal it, or refuse.
LanguageData.Dominion_Standing_JustOnce_Desc: Leave it as a one-time trade.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ledger_Empty: No standing deals yet. Trade with a faction from the Diplomacy tab, then offer to repeat the trade.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ledger_Button_Desc: Every standing deal: what is due when, with buttons to resume or call one off.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Button_Desc: Request an audience with {0}: a longer conversation where you can make small talk, settle grievances, trade rumours and threats, ask for help in your wars, trade, or propose a treaty. Once every {1} days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Refused: {0} refuses to receive your envoy while you are at war. A war-weary or less aggressive enemy might.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Patience_Desc: How much longer {0} will listen. Each exchange uses one lamp; going back between topics does not. Honour and a good opinion of you give more patience.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_SmallTalk_Desc: Pleasantries. Warms most leaders a little, festive and gentle ones more; does nothing for those who already dislike you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Grievances_Desc: Settle what stands between you: apologise, pay amends, or demand an apology from them.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Rumours_Desc: Ask about their rivals, pass on a rumour about another faction, or warn them of a danger.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Threats_Desc: Remind them of your strength, or demand tribute.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Help_Desc: Ask them to join one of your wars.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Apologise_Desc: Apologise for what you did to {0}. Honourable and gentle leaders may forgive a large part of their grievance; aggressive ones want more than words.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Amends_Desc: Pay silver to make up for what you did to {0}. Always eases their grievance, more the more you pay.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_NoTheirGrievance: {0} holds no grievance against you worth settling.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Intimidate_Desc: Your strength is {1} of {0}'s. The weak and the timid grow careful and drop their grudges; the proud and the aggressive are provoked.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_LogAmends: You paid {0} silver in amends to {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_LogProvoked: {0} took your show of strength as a provocation.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_SmallTalk: How have you been? How are your people?
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Apology: We regret what happened between us. We apologise.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Amends: We want to set things right. Accept {0} silver in amends.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Intimidate: Consider carefully. You know what we can do.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Tribute: We expect tribute. A letter with our terms follows.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Deal: Let's talk trade. Open your stores to us.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Treaty: We have a treaty to propose.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Praise: Your people are a credit to you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Complain: We have a complaint, and we expect an apology.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_AskRivals: Whom do you trust out there, and whom don't you?
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_AskWants: What do you want from us? Speak plainly.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_ShareRumour: You should know what we have heard about {0}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Audience_Said_Warn: A word of warning: you are in danger.
LanguageData.Dominion_God_ResetTalk: Reset audience and talk cooldowns with {0}
